title: The Morning Ritual
prompt: A ~30s specialty pour-over coffee brand ad. It sells the morning ritual and that sense of unhurried calm — no specs, no features — so that after watching you want to slowly brew yourself a cup. Warm, slow-paced, quality-lifestyle tone. The user supplies the product packaging image and logo; brand identity must stay consistent. English, no voice-over; a single short slogan subtitle is allowed.
